lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Little Hill Village. Dawn, and the fields are too quiet.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: {hero}. Come here. The birds did not sing this morning.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: I have kept this egg since the last war. It was cold for years. Today it is warm again.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: A grey fog is on the hills. The creatures are forgetting their words.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: Talk to Farmer Li in the field, and to Grandpa Wang here in the village. Then meet me at the old well.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: I'll go. Is the egg safe {C594}?

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: I will wait with it. Go carefully.
